items.title: Live: Nifty recovers 100 pts from day's low; Oil at $96, rupee back above 94/$ | Closing Bell
items.description: Catch all the closing action on Dalal Street as the market staged a recovery from the day’s low. The Nifty bounced back by over 100 points to move back above the 25,000 mark, while the Sensex recovered more than 400 points from its lows, even as market breadth stayed negative with declines outpacing advances. On the sector front, pharma stocks cheered strong Q2 results, with Divi’s Lab and Laurus Lab hitting fresh record highs. The Bank Nifty outperformed led by HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank, and the PSU banking index surged 3% on the back of SBI. IT stocks stayed under pressure, weighed down by TCS, Infosys and HCL Tech. On the global front, Brent crude hovered around $96 per barrel and the rupee traded near 94 against the dollar. Among Nifty 50 stocks, SBI, HDFC Bank and L&T were the top gainers, while HCL Tech, Tata Steel and UltraTech Cement were the top losers. Stay tuned for expert views, stock-specific action and everything you need to know before session.

items.title: Follow The Foreign Money: Ajay Srivastav’s Midcap And Banking Picks For This Bull Market
items.description: In this conversation, Ajay Srivastav, CEO of Dimensions Corporate Finance Services, makes the case for smart investing over just talking investing, and his core message is simple: don’t forget to book profits in a bull market. He explains why he is leaning towards midcaps rather than large caps, where he sees the stronger growth runway from here. He also shares his view on the defence sector, which he is not a fan of, and explains why he prefers mid-tier banks. He also talks about tracking where foreign money is flowing, and why stocks seeing fresh foreign inflows deserve a spot on your watchlist. A useful watch for anyone trying to balance growth, discipline and timing in a rising market.
